privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: CaboFeira ("we", "us", "our") operates a classifieds marketplace for Cabo Verde. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using CaboFeira, you agree to the collection and use of information as described here.
privacyPage.s1Body:
Account information: when you register, we collect your name, email address, phone number (optional) and password (stored securely by our backend provider, Supabase, using industry-standard hashing — we never see your plain-text password).

Listings and content: any ad you post, including title, description, price, category, location and photos, is stored and shown publicly on the marketplace.

Messages: when you contact a buyer or seller through CaboFeira, the content of those messages is stored so both people in the conversation can see the message history.

Usage and device data: we automatically log basic technical data such as browser type and pages viewed, used only to keep the service reliable and secure.

Cookies and local storage: we use your browser's local storage to remember your language preference and to keep you signed in between visits. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.
privacyPage.s2Body:
We use the information we collect to operate and improve the marketplace: to create and secure your account, publish and manage your listings, deliver messages between buyers and sellers, respond to support requests, and detect fraud or abuse.

We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacyPage.s3Body: Your display name and any contact details you choose to show on a listing (such as a phone number) are visible to anyone browsing that listing. Your email address is never shown publicly. When you message another user, that user can see your display name and message content.
privacyPage.s4Body: We share information with Supabase, the infrastructure provider that hosts our database, authentication and image storage, solely to operate the service. We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect the rights, safety and property of CaboFeira, our users, or the public.
privacyPage.s5Body: We rely on Supabase's security controls, including encrypted connections and access-control rules, to protect your data. No online service can guarantee absolute security, but we work to keep your information safe and to fix vulnerabilities promptly.
privacyPage.s6Body: You can review and update your account details at any time from your profile. You may delete individual listings yourself. To request a copy of your data or full account deletion, contact us using the details below — we will action your request within a reasonable time.
privacyPage.s7Body: We keep your account and listing data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove your personal data and listings, except where we must keep limited records to comply with legal obligations or resolve disputes.
privacyPage.s8Body: CaboFeira is not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can remove it.
privacyPage.s9Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make significant changes, we will post the updated policy on this page with a new "last updated" date.
privacyPage.s10Body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, contact us at {email}.

termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.intro: These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your access to and use of CaboFeira. By creating an account or using our marketplace, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use CaboFeira.
termsPage.s1Body: You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity that happens under your account. Let us know right away if you suspect unauthorized use of your account.
termsPage.s2Body: You can post listings for free; some optional features, such as featured placement, may have a fee shown before you confirm. You are responsible for the accuracy of your listing, including the price, description, condition and photos of what you're selling. Listings must represent items or services you are genuinely able to sell or provide.
termsPage.s3Body:
You may not use CaboFeira to post or facilitate: illegal goods or services, weapons or ammunition, drugs or drug paraphernalia, counterfeit or stolen goods, live animals prohibited by local law, adult content, or anything that infringes someone else's rights.

You also may not use the marketplace to harass, threaten or defraud other users, post spam or misleading listings, scrape or misuse other users' data, or attempt to interfere with the normal operation of the service.

We may remove listings or messages, and suspend or terminate accounts, that violate these rules.
termsPage.s4Body:
CaboFeira is a platform that connects buyers and sellers — we are not a party to any transaction between users and do not handle payments, delivery or guarantees on items sold. You are responsible for verifying the other party, the item, and agreeing on payment and delivery directly with them.

For your safety, meet in public places when possible, inspect items before paying, and never share banking passwords, one-time codes, or other sensitive financial information with another user.
termsPage.s5Body: You keep ownership of the content you post (listing text, photos, messages). By posting on CaboFeira, you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to display and distribute that content on the platform for as long as it stays published. You confirm you have the right to post the content you upload.
termsPage.s6Body: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms, misuse the platform, or if required by law. You may stop using CaboFeira and request deletion of your account at any time.
termsPage.s7Body: CaboFeira is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee the accuracy of listings, the conduct of users, or that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free. To the fullest extent permitted by law, CaboFeira is not liable for disputes, losses or damages arising from transactions or interactions between users.
termsPage.s8Body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Cabo Verde. Any dispute arising from these Terms or your use of CaboFeira will be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts of Cabo Verde.
termsPage.s9Body: We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make significant changes, we will post the updated Terms on this page with a new "last updated" date. Continuing to use CaboFeira after changes take effect means you accept the updated Terms.
termsPage.s10Body: If you have questions about these Terms, contact us at {email}.
